summary: Candidate context-specific EXP for browser-assisted Grammarly AI-pattern review of Barry's academic Word manuscripts, with local-first revision, bounded batches, exact mapping, reversible write-back, and evidence-backed stabilisation.

context.task_family: academic manuscript review and revision using Grammarly as a sparse external evaluator
context.data_boundary: Exact manuscript text and provider receipts remain in confidential AIRMS run folders; this EXP stores only generalised operational knowledge and provenance pointers.

authority.external_evaluator: Grammarly observations are evidence, not authorship or misconduct findings

scope_limits: Known only for Barry's academic Word manuscripts on the HASHI Windows desktop and the current Grammarly Docs interface.
Not a generic AI-authorship detector, plagiarism check, misconduct assessment, or guarantee that prose was human-authored.
Not a detector-evasion workflow; academic quality, factual fidelity, citations, and Barry's voice outrank a provider score.
No manuscript unit may be uploaded merely because it was extracted locally; explicit scope approval and a positive allowlist are required.
Same-document whole-batch replacement is not yet validated on Grammarly's current Coda editor and must be proven on disposable text before production use.
The candidate has not completed a real end-to-end batch through revision, recheck, Word write-back, and user acceptance.
